project_type: Monorepo at 4astore-v2: React Native Expo mobile app (mobile/) + Node Express/Prisma/MySQL API (api-node/) + React web (web/). This task touches mobile/ and one file-set in api-node/.
build_system: Mobile: Expo SDK 54 (expo ~54.0.37), RN 0.81.5, React 19.1.0, expo-router ~6, @tanstack/react-query 5.104.0, zustand 5. Server: Express ^4.19.2, @prisma/client ^5.19.0, tsc build. No bundler changes needed for typecheck.
test_framework: Mobile has a node:test runner (npm test) but it is NOT the gate for this task. The gate is tsc --noEmit on both projects (see test_command/verification_instructions).
build_command: Mobile: cd 4astore-v2/mobile; npm install. Server: cd 4astore-v2/api-node; npm install.
test_command: Mobile: cd 4astore-v2/mobile; npx tsc --noEmit. Server: cd 4astore-v2/api-node; npx tsc --noEmit.
verification_instructions: MOBILE baseline: `npm install` then `npx tsc --noEmit` yields EXACTLY ONE known error: app.config.ts(39) TS2353 'usesCleartextTraffic does not exist in type Android'. A change is clean iff this remains the ONLY error (no NEW errors). SERVER baseline in THIS sandbox: `npx tsc --noEmit` yields 84 PRE-EXISTING errors across 14 files, ALL from the untyped Prisma client because `prisma generate` cannot download its query engine behind the TLS proxy here (codes: 57xTS2347, 18xTS7006, 5xTS2339, 3xTS2345, 1xTS18046; src/routes/orders.ts(21) already errors). DO NOT try to fix these. Server change is clean iff: error count does not exceed 84, no new error code/file appears outside the pre-existing untyped-Prisma set, and `express-async-errors` resolves (no Cannot-find-module error). If a machine CAN run `prisma generate` (no proxy), server baseline is 0 and the same no-new-errors rule applies.
snapshot_or_generated_files: api-node Prisma client is generated by `prisma generate` (prisma/schema.prisma). It CANNOT be generated in this sandbox (TLS proxy blocks binaries.prisma.sh). This is why the server tsc baseline is 84 untyped-Prisma errors, not 0. No other generated/checked-in snapshots are affected by this task.
environment_constraints: `prisma generate` fails here with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' (corporate TLS proxy) -> do not rely on a clean server tsc. All work is in the git worktree c:/xampp/htdocs/static4a/.worktrees/app-slow-loaders-login on branch app-slow-loaders-login (base commit f44f1b98, clean). RELATIVE paths resolve to the PARENT workspace, not the worktree -> always use the absolute worktree paths given per feature. Never push.
contribution_requirements: No new npm dependency EXCEPT: server may add express-async-errors pinned EXACT 3.1.1 (Express-4 compatible). Mobile must add NO new dependency (social login uses a credential-gated fallback; do NOT add expo-auth-session/expo-web-browser — Expo prebuild/gradle build risk). Preserve bilingual Hindi/English copy, accessibility labels, and the design tokens in src/theme.ts.
key_patterns: Toast is thrown by src/api.ts api() on a 15s AbortController timeout (+ one GET auto-retry) with message 'Server slow hai / timeout...'. Background polls (useAllOrders 7s staff / 12s rider via refetchInterval; track 8s; rider 12s) drive the toast on any dropped poll -> they must become `silent`. Skeletons use the Shimmer component in src/components/ui.tsx; the GOOD model is OrdersSkeleton in app/(tabs)/orders.tsx. Buttons: GradientButton/Button; inputs: Field/PasswordField; branded gradient: AnimatedGradient + warmGradient (src/theme.ts). Optimistic staff status update in admin/order/[id].tsx setStatus() must stay EXACTLY as-is (no button spinner, cache update + rollback+toast). Local-first caches: persistCache.ts (loadOrdersCache/savePageCache/loadPageCache + restoreCache storefront snapshot). SERVER: no password-reset endpoint and no social-login endpoint exist; recovery-email OTP endpoints are auth-gated (requireAuth); /otp/send is a PUBLIC signup OTP.
